title: Junior Business Intelligence Developer
description:
On behalf of a partner company, Nordic Investin is looking for a Junior Business Intelligence Developer. You want your first major BI role to involve real users, real decisions and experienced colleagues who will help you sharpen both technical and analytical judgement.
  
The partner is expanding its reporting capability and needs a developer who can turn well defined business questions into clear, maintainable dashboards. You will work with senior data colleagues and gradually own complete reporting areas.
  
The partner wants data and AI work that can be operated, explained and improved after launch. Provenance, quality, access and evaluation belong in the solution from the beginning.
  
How you will work
  
You will work with engineers, analysts and domain specialists who look at the same information from different angles. The partner expects assumptions, datasets and evaluation methods to be visible. Solutions should be designed for repeatable delivery, monitored use and responsible change after deployment.
  
You will work with experienced colleagues who review both the outcome and the reasoning behind it. The partner expects curiosity, care and steady growth rather than instant expertise. You will receive real responsibility in controlled steps and clear opportunities to build evidence of your capability.
  
What you will do
  
Build and maintain Power BI reports and semantic models.
  
  

Write SQL queries and validate source data.
  
  

Clarify requirements with business users.
  
  

Test measures, filters and refresh behaviour.
  
  

Document definitions and report ownership.
  
  

Support users and improve dashboards from feedback.
  
  

What you will bring
  
Education or early professional experience in data, IT, engineering or economics.
  
  

Working SQL knowledge.
  
  

Experience with Power BI, Tableau or a similar tool.
  
  

Basic understanding of data modelling.
  
  

Careful communication and willingness to ask precise questions.
  
  

Professional English; Swedish is useful in user facing environments.
  
  

Experience that would add value
  
DAX, Power Query or Microsoft Fabric.
  
  

Internship or project using operational business data.
  
  

Interest in finance, logistics or public sector reporting.
  
  

A background that can succeed here
  
You might be a recent graduate, a support analyst moving into BI or a business controller with strong technical ability. We care about how you check your work and explain a number, not whether you have used every tool in the stack.
  
What makes the opportunity interesting
  
You will receive meaningful responsibility with access to experienced support. The partner offers a practical learning curve and work that becomes visible quickly when a team gains a report it can finally trust.
  
The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.
  
The recruitment conversation
  
During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.
  
How to apply
  
Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
Nordic Investin is recruiting a ServiceNow Developer on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want to develop ServiceNow as a serious enterprise platform, with clean configuration, useful automation and code that remains supportable.


The partner operates a large ServiceNow environment that supports customer delivery and internal work. You will join an agile team developing existing capabilities and introducing new modules at a steady pace.


The work spans organisational boundaries and requires both technical understanding and disciplined communication. Decisions must remain useful when they reach delivery teams, suppliers and operational owners.

### **How you will work**


You will work across teams with different incentives, technical histories and decision rights. The partner expects concise preparation, visible dependencies and follow through after meetings. Strong performance means that people understand what was decided, why it matters and what they now own.


You will receive meaningful ownership while working with senior colleagues on the most consequential decisions. The partner expects you to deliver independently within a clear area, ask for context early and contribute ideas grounded in what you observe. There is room to deepen your specialism or broaden toward adjacent responsibilities.

### **What you will do**

* Configure and develop workflows, forms and business logic.
* Build integrations using APIs, IntegrationHub and platform capabilities.
* Create maintainable scripts and scoped applications.
* Write automated tests and support controlled releases.
* Investigate platform issues and performance concerns.
* Collaborate with process owners and translate needs into platform solutions.

### **What you will bring**

* Professional ServiceNow development experience.
* JavaScript and platform scripting ability.
* Knowledge of data models, ACLs and application scope.
* Experience with integrations and REST APIs.
* Understanding of agile delivery and source control practices.
* Professional English; Swedish is required for some partner environments.

### **Experience that would add value**

* ITSM, CSM, HRSD or another major ServiceNow module.
* ServiceNow certifications.
* Experience in a large multi department installation.

### **A background that can succeed here**


Your background may be platform administration, JavaScript development, IT service management or consulting. The partner values developers who understand the process impact of a change and resist unnecessary customisation.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


You will work on a mature platform with an ambitious roadmap and experienced colleagues. The role provides variety across configuration, code, integration and direct business collaboration.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.

### **The recruitment conversation**


During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

title: Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform Developer
description:
Nordic Investin has been engaged by a partner company to find a Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform Developer. You want to build enterprise AI and automation that survives contact with real processes, permissions and data.


The partner is introducing intelligent agents and low code solutions across internal workflows. You will design Copilot Studio agents, Power Apps and Power Automate flows that integrate safely with Microsoft 365 and enterprise systems.


The platform is treated as a service used by engineers and business teams. Success will be measured through safer change, lower operational friction and clearer ownership rather than the number of tools introduced.

### **How you will work**


The work combines planned platform development with investigation of real production behaviour. You will collaborate with application teams, security and operations, using their feedback to decide what should become a shared service, an automated control or clear documentation. Ownership continues after the first release.


You will receive meaningful ownership while working with senior colleagues on the most consequential decisions. The partner expects you to deliver independently within a clear area, ask for context early and contribute ideas grounded in what you observe. There is room to deepen your specialism or broaden toward adjacent responsibilities.

### **What you will do**

* Develop and operate Copilot Studio agents for business processes.
* Build Power Apps and Power Automate solutions.
* Model data and permissions in Dataverse.
* Integrate Microsoft 365, SharePoint, APIs and Azure services.
* Apply environment, lifecycle and governance standards.
* Work with users to test behaviour and improve adoption.

### **What you will bring**

* Hands on Power Platform solution delivery.
* Experience with Copilot Studio or conversational agent development.
* Good understanding of Dataverse security and solution management.
* Ability to build connectors and API integrations.
* Awareness of data protection, identity and enterprise governance.
* Professional English; Swedish is valuable for user facing work.

### **Experience that would add value**

* Azure Functions or custom connector development.
* Microsoft 365 administration or SharePoint development.
* Experience moving prototypes into governed production use.

### **A background that can succeed here**


You may come from software development, business applications, automation or technical consulting. The right person combines process curiosity with enough engineering depth to recognise when low code needs a coded extension.

### **What makes the opportunity interesting**


You will work close to users and see solutions adopted quickly. The partner offers a growing platform, visible use cases and the opportunity to set patterns before the organisation scales its agent portfolio.


The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.

### **The recruitment conversation**


During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.

### **How to apply**


Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

title: Senior Developer
description:
*Vi tror på ett samhälle format av framgångsrika företag där entreprenörskap och samhällsnytta går hand i hand. Att vara en del av Fortnox är att vara en del av en ständig förändring - en förändring där du själv bestämmer hur långt du vill nå. Vårt största fokus är att ge dig rätt förutsättningar att få leva din passion tillsammans med oss. Var du kommer ifrån är inte relevant - det är vart du är på väg som är intressant för oss. Precis som vi igår inte kunde drömma om det Fortnox som finns idag, så kan du vara med och forma vilka vi är imorgon.*


**Om tjänsten**


I Stockholm bygger vi nu vidare på teamen och söker ytterligare en kollega. Vi är ett dedikerat team som ska stötta och lyfta våra medarbetare i deras AI-resa, tillsammans ska vi skapa en medarbetarupplevelse i världsklass.


Vi utvecklar hela funktioner "från ax till limpa" – databearbetning, dataanalys, algoritm- och agentutveckling samt backend och frontend.


Vår produktutveckling handlar om att implementera AI, självklart med hjälp av AI, vi använder oss av Claude i utveckling och bygger integrationer i våra system. Nästa steg är att utveckla agentbaserade lösningar – digitala agenter som självständigt kan utföra uppgifter åt våra anställda, byggda på Google Gemini Enterprise och moderna LLM-ramverk. Målet är att våra anställda ska lägga minimal tid på administration och istället fokusera på att utveckla Fortnox.


Du blir en central, senior del av ett autonomt team med helhetsansvar för sina produkter – från idé till produktion. Vi arbetar agilt och produktnära, med stort fokus på teknik, innovation och medarbetarnytta.


**Vem är du?**
  

Vi tror att du är en person som trivs i en samarbetsinriktad miljö där vi delar kunskap, bollar idéer och utforskar ny teknik tillsammans.


Vi söker dig som:


* Har gedigen erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och känner dig trygg i hela utvecklingscykeln.
* Har goda kunskaper i Go (eller stark erfarenhet i liknande språk och vilja att arbeta i Go).
* Har ett genuint intresse för, eller tidigare erfarenhet av, AI, LLM:er och agent-orkestrering.
* Har god erfarenhet av integrationsutveckling och att bygga/konsumera REST-API:er
* Trivs med att samarbeta i team, stötta kollegor och kontinuerligt lära dig nya verktyg och metoder.
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift.

Det är ett plus om du har erfarenhet av:


* AI-assisterade utvecklingsverktyg och moderna ramverk för agenter som Claude, Gemini mfl.
* Moln- och mikrotjänstarkitektur (t.ex. Kubernetes, Kafka, SQL).
* Frontendutveckling i React.

Som senior utvecklare i teamet får du ett stort mandat att forma hur Fortnox medarbetare möter och använder AI i sitt dagliga arbete. Du kommer att utvecklas tekniskt tillsammans med erfarna och kompetenta utvecklare, med stor möjlighet att påverka hur vi bygger och förädlar de AI-agenter och verktyg som ska ge Fortnox en medarbetarupplevelse i världsklass, från ett tidigt skede.


**Fortnox - mitt i företagslivet**
  

*Fortnox hjälper företag att starta, växa och utvecklas. Med smarta tekniska lösningar för företag och redovisningsbyråer, smidig finansiering och ett ekosystem av starka partnerskap är Fortnox ett nav för företagande i Sverige. Vi drivs av visionen om ett välmående samhälle format av framgångsrika företag.*


*Fortnox grundades 2001 med huvudkontor i Växjö. Läs mer på www.fortnoxgroup.com.*


**Välkommen med din ansökan!**


**Behandling av personuppgifter**


Vi på Fortnox värnar om din personliga integritet. När du skickar in din ansökan till oss kommer vi att behandla dina personuppgifter för att administrera rekryteringsprocessen. Personuppgiftsansvarig är det bolag som du söker arbete hos och är något bolag inom Fortnoxkoncernen. Du kan läsa integritetsmeddelandet i sin helhet på följande länk:


https://apps.fortnox.se/api/eula/document-v1/privacy-policy-recruiting

title: Java Systemutvecklare inom Realtidsnära System
description:
### **Job description**


Är du en Java-utvecklare med erfarenhet av komplexa mjukvarusystem, systemintegration och datadriven utveckling? Drivs du av att utveckla robusta lösningar som hanterar stora mängder sensordata och trivs i miljöer där mjukvara och hårdvara samverkar? Då kan du vara helt rätt för oss!
Vi bygger nu upp ett nytt team inom avancerad systemutveckling och söker därför fler Java-utvecklare som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens lösningar för realtidsnära datahantering, sensorintegration och komplexa tekniska system.
Du brinner för teknikutveckling och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom avancerad mjukvaruutveckling tillsammans med erfarna kollegor och kunder inom tekniskt utmanande verksamheter.
I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla serverbaserade applikationer i Java för avancerade tekniska system.
* Arbeta med insamling, bearbetning och distribution av stora mängder sensordata.
* Utveckla funktionalitet för system med höga krav på prestanda, robusthet och tillförlitlighet.
* Delta i utveckling och integration av mjukvara mot sensorer, tekniska plattformar och fysisk hårdvara.
* Arbeta med distribuerade system och kommunikationslösningar.
* Delta i testning, verifiering och felsökning av komplexa system där både mjukvara och hårdvara ingår.
* Bidra till utveckling och förbättring av automatiserade testlösningar och integrationsmiljöer.
* Säkerställa hög kvalitet genom testning, kodgranskning och moderna utvecklingsmetoder.
* Arbeta med bygg- och versionshantering genom verktyg som Maven, Gradle, GitHub och GitLab.
* Arbeta i Linux-baserade utvecklings- och testmiljöer.
* Samarbeta med systemingenjörer, testutvecklare och andra utvecklingsteam i tvärfunktionella miljöer.

Vem är du?


* B.Sc. eller M.Sc. inom datavetenskap, systemutveckling, teknisk fysik, elektroteknik eller motsvarande område.
* +3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling med Java som primärt språk.
* God erfarenhet av objektorienterad design och utveckling.
* Erfarenhet av serverapplikationer, distribuerade system eller prestandakritiska applikationer.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med dataströmmar, större datamängder eller realtidsnära datahantering.
* Erfarenhet av testning, verifiering och systemintegration.
* Erfarenhet av Linux-baserade utvecklingsmiljöer.
* Kunskap inom multitrådning och samtidighet är meriterande.
* Erfarenhet av utveckling nära hårdvara, sensorer eller tekniska system är meriterande.
* Kunskap eller erfarenhet av programmering i Ada är meriterande.
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom R&D, automotive, försvarsindustri, telekom eller andra tekniskt avancerade verksamheter är meriterande.
* Kännedom om agila arbetssätt såsom Scrum eller Kanban.
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
* Svenskt medborgarskap.

Vi tror att du


* Trivs med att lösa tekniskt komplexa problem i samarbete med andra utvecklare.
* Gillar att arbeta i miljöer där mjukvara, sensorer och hårdvara möts.
* Har ett genuint teknikintresse och vill utvecklas inom avancerade system.
* Är nyfiken, kvalitetsmedveten och noggrann i ditt arbete.
* Trivs i team där kunskapsdelning och samarbete är en naturlig del av vardagen.
### **We offer**


Vi är stora nog för att kunna erbjuda en bred kundbas och vi har ett gott rykte i branschen, samtidigt som vi är små nog att se dig som individ. För oss är gemenskap viktigt – här ska alla känna sig sedda och välkomna. Som en följd av detta har vi bland annat gemensamma sektionsaktiviteter, ett nätverk för kvinnor och icke-binära, ett mentorskapsprogam och utbildningar inom olika kompetensområden. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla kan växa och utvecklas tillsammans. Vår ambition är att tillgodose konsultens önskemål gällande uppdragslängd, sektor och arbetsuppgifter. För oss är en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv en självklarhet och vi är stolta över att vara en av Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare. Givetvis har vi också kollektivavtal.


Nyfiken på hur det känns att vara en del av vårt gäng? I den här filmen delar några av våra medarbetare med sig av sina tankar om vardagen, gemenskapen och varför de valt just oss: **https://vimeo.com/1058313176?share=copy#t=0**

  

**OM SID**

Sigma Industry Development är ett teknik- och konsultbolag inom Sigmagruppen som hjälper både ledande svenska och internationella teknikföretag och innovativa och nytänkande start-ups och scale-ups. Vi verkar inom sektorer så som den gröna energisektorn, fordonsindustrin, transportindustrin, medtech, försvarsbranchen och hållbarhet.


Vår vision är att vara det ledande teknikkonsultbolaget och vår kultur präglas av familjär samhörighet där människan är i centrum. Med över 100 engagerade medarbetare är vi i en stark tillväxtfas. Vår kärnverksamhet ligger i konsultuppdrag ute hos kund, men vi har även ett in-house-team som arbetar uteslutande från kontoret. Precis som vårt namn antyder, är utveckling kärnan i allt vi gör och våra medarbetare engageras av att ta Sigma Industry Development till nästa nivå.  



  

**OM SIGMA GROUP**

Sigma Industry Development AB (SID) är ett av sex dotterbolag som ingår i koncernen Sigma Industry East/North Group, vilka i sin tur ingår i Sigma Group (som ägs av familjekoncernen Danir AB). Läs mer om Sigma Industry Development **HÄR** och om Sigma Group på **HÄR**.


Utöver att vara del av ett företag som värnar om teknologisk utveckling, arbetar för en bättre miljö och som främjar jämställdhet, så är en viktig del av vår verksamhet socialt ansvarstagande. Mer information om detta hittar du **HÄR**.

title: Senior Systemutvecklare Java & Sensorbaserade System
description:
### **Job description**


Är du en erfaren Java-utvecklare med stark kompetens inom avancerade mjukvarusystem, realtidsnära datahantering och systemintegration? Drivs du av att utveckla robusta lösningar som hanterar stora mängder sensordata samtidigt som du säkerställer hög prestanda, tillgänglighet och kvalitet? Då kan du vara helt rätt för oss!
Vi bygger nu upp ett nytt team inom avancerad Java-utveckling och söker därför erfarna utvecklare som vill vara med och forma framtida lösningar och arbetssätt.
Du brinner för teknikutveckling och håller dig naturligt uppdaterad kring moderna metoder, verktyg och arbetssätt inom Java-utveckling.
I rollen kommer du att vara både strategisk och hands-on inom avancerad systemutveckling, bland annat genom att:
* Utveckla och vidareutveckla serverbaserade applikationer i Java för komplexa tekniska system.
* Designa och implementera lösningar för insamling, bearbetning och distribution av stora mängder sensordata.
* Utveckla funktionalitet för realtidsnära datahantering där höga krav ställs på prestanda, robusthet och tillförlitlighet.
* Arbeta med integration mellan mjukvara, sensorer, tekniska plattformar och annan fysisk hårdvara.
* Delta i design och implementation av distribuerade system och kommunikationslösningar.
* Arbeta med testning, verifiering och felsökning i komplexa miljöer där både mjukvara och hårdvara ingår.
* Bidra till utveckling och förbättring av automatiserade testlösningar och integrationsmiljöer.
* Säkerställa hög kodkvalitet genom kodgranskningar, teststrategier och moderna utvecklingsmetoder.
* Arbeta med bygg- och versionshantering genom verktyg som Maven, Gradle, GitHub och GitLab.
* Arbeta i Linux-baserade utvecklings- och testmiljöer.
* Bidra till tekniska beslut kring lösningsdesign, arkitektur och systemutveckling samtidigt som du förblir operativ i utvecklingsarbetet.
* Stötta och dela kunskap med övriga utvecklare i teamet.

Vem är du?


* B.Sc. eller M.Sc. inom datavetenskap, systemutveckling, teknisk fysik, elektroteknik eller motsvarande område.
* Minst 8 års arbetslivserfarenhet av professionell mjukvaruutveckling med Java som primärt språk.
* Mycket god erfarenhet av objektorienterad design och utveckling av komplexa mjukvarusystem.
* Erfarenhet av serverapplikationer, distribuerade system eller andra prestandakritiska applikationer.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med stora datamängder, dataströmmar eller realtidsnära datahantering.
* Erfarenhet av multitrådning, samtidighet och prestandaoptimering.
* Erfarenhet av testning, verifiering och systemintegration.
* Erfarenhet av Linux-baserade utvecklingsmiljöer.
* Erfarenhet av utveckling nära hårdvara, sensorer eller tekniska system är starkt meriterande.
* Kunskap eller erfarenhet av programmering i Ada är meriterande.
* Erfarenhet av arbete inom R&D, automotive, försvarsindustri, telekom eller andra tekniskt avancerade verksamheter är meriterande.
* Kännedom om agila arbetssätt såsom Scrum eller Kanban.
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
* Svenskt medborgarskap.

Vi tror att du


* Gillar att lösa komplexa tekniska problem och ta ansvar för hela kedjan från design till verifiering.
* Trivs i miljöer där mjukvara, sensorer och hårdvara samverkar.
* Har ett genuint teknikintresse och vill förstå hur hela system fungerar.
* Är en lagspelare som gärna delar med sig av kunskap och bidrar till teamets utveckling.
* Trivs i en roll där du får kombinera tekniskt djup med praktiskt utvecklingsarbete.
### **We offer**


Vi är stora nog för att kunna erbjuda en bred kundbas och vi har ett gott rykte i branschen, samtidigt som vi är små nog att se dig som individ. För oss är gemenskap viktigt – här ska alla känna sig sedda och välkomna. Som en följd av detta har vi bland annat gemensamma sektionsaktiviteter, ett nätverk för kvinnor och icke-binära, ett mentorskapsprogam och utbildningar inom olika kompetensområden. Vi strävar efter att skapa en miljö där alla kan växa och utvecklas tillsammans. Vår ambition är att tillgodose konsultens önskemål gällande uppdragslängd, sektor och arbetsuppgifter. För oss är en bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv en självklarhet och vi är stolta över att vara en av Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare. Givetvis har vi också kollektivavtal.


Nyfiken på hur det känns att vara en del av vårt gäng? I den här filmen delar några av våra medarbetare med sig av sina tankar om vardagen, gemenskapen och varför de valt just oss: **https://vimeo.com/1058313176?share=copy#t=0**

  

**OM SID**

Sigma Industry Development är ett teknik- och konsultbolag inom Sigmagruppen som hjälper både ledande svenska och internationella teknikföretag och innovativa och nytänkande start-ups och scale-ups. Vi verkar inom sektorer så som den gröna energisektorn, fordonsindustrin, transportindustrin, medtech, försvarsbranchen och hållbarhet.


Vår vision är att vara det ledande teknikkonsultbolaget och vår kultur präglas av familjär samhörighet där människan är i centrum. Med över 100 engagerade medarbetare är vi i en stark tillväxtfas. Vår kärnverksamhet ligger i konsultuppdrag ute hos kund, men vi har även ett in-house-team som arbetar uteslutande från kontoret. Precis som vårt namn antyder, är utveckling kärnan i allt vi gör och våra medarbetare engageras av att ta Sigma Industry Development till nästa nivå.  



  

**OM SIGMA GROUP**

Sigma Industry Development AB (SID) är ett av sex dotterbolag som ingår i koncernen Sigma Industry East/North Group, vilka i sin tur ingår i Sigma Group (som ägs av familjekoncernen Danir AB). Läs mer om Sigma Industry Development **HÄR** och om Sigma Group på **HÄR**.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
**Craft:**
 Technology & Development
   

  

**Job Description:**
 King operates games at a massive scale, serving hundreds of millions of players around the world. Behind every player experience is a large ecosystem of services, data platforms, forecasting systems, and internal tools that help our teams make better decisions, move faster, and deliver exceptional experiences.
   

  

 We are looking for a Developer (Python) to help design, build, and operate backend services, internal applications, and data-driven platforms that support critical business and product decisions across King. You will work on systems that process large volumes of data, run forecasting and analytical workloads, and provide reliable APIs and services consumed by teams across the company.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, analysts, product managers, and business stakeholders to build scalable solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights. This role combines backend engineering, distributed systems, cloud-native development, and data-intensive applications. While the primary focus of the role is backend engineering, you will also contribute to user-facing internal applications, helping deliver end-to-end solutions that enable teams across King to work more effectively.
   

  

 An important part of the role will be integrating our platforms and tools with the broader King and Microsoft ecosystem, enabling seamless collaboration,
   

  

 authentication, data exchange, and workflow automation across multiple services and platforms.
   

  

 King is a place where we build collaboratively and value diverse perspectives. We encourage experimentation, continuous learning, and ownership. You will have the opportunity to contribute to impactful projects, solve challenging technical problems, and work alongside experienced engineers in a supportive environment.
   

  

 Your Role Within the Kingdom
   

  

 You will enjoy a creative, challenging, and collaborative environment where your ideas will be valued as much as your technical expertise.
   

  

 Some of your responsibilities include:
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs using Python
* Build scalable and reliable applications that support forecasting, analytics, and decision-making processes across the business
* Develop distributed processing pipelines and asynchronous workloads
* Design and optimize relational OLTP databases, data models, and query performance
* Build and maintain data processing, analytical, and forecasting workflows
* Design, develop, and maintain internal web applications when required
* Build intuitive interfaces and workflows that enable technical and non-technical users to interact with backend systems and business tools
* Integrate services with the King and Microsoft ecosystems, including identity, collaboration, communication, and productivity platforms
* Develop and maintain APIs and connectors that enable interoperability between internal and external systems
* Deploy, monitor, and operate containerized applications in cloud-native environments
* Contribute to technical designs, architectural discussions, and engineering best practices
* Improve system reliability, observability, performance, and operational excellence
* Deliver high-quality, well-tested, maintainable code
* Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing initiatives across teams
* Support CI/CD pipelines and automation practices throughout the software development lifecycle


 Skills to Create Thrills
   

  

 You are a software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and building reliable systems that operate at scale. You are curious, pragmatic, and motivated by creating high-quality solutions that deliver measurable impact.
   

  

* Strong Python development experience in production environments
* Experience building backend services and APIs
* Understanding of modern web application development and the ability to contribute across the stack when needed
* Solid understanding of asynchronous programming, concurrency, and distributed systems
* Experience designing and optimizing relational databases
* Experience building data-intensive applications and processing large datasets
* Experience with background processing, job orchestration, or distributed workloads
* Experience deploying and operating applications in containerized and cloud-native environments
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices and automation pipelines
* Strong testing, debugging, and problem-solving skills
* Strong communication and collaboration skills
* Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams
* High sense of code quality and the desire to build and maintain robust, reliable software
* Curiosity and adaptability when learning new technologies and domains


 Technologies We Use
   

  

 Our technology stack evolves over time, but currently includes:
   

  

* Python
* FastAPI
* Django
* HTMX
* TypeScript
* PostgreSQL
* Pandas
* NumPy
* SciPy
* Celery
* Docker
* Kubernetes
* Drone CI


 Experience with all technologies is not required. We value strong engineering
   

  

 fundamentals and the ability to learn new tools and technologies as needed.
   

  

 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience building forecasting, optimization, simulation, or analytics platforms
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform or other major cloud providers
* Experience integrating with Microsoft technologies and services such as Microsoft
* Entra ID (Azure AD), Microsoft Graph, Teams, SharePoint, or related enterprise platforms
* Experience building internal developer platforms, business applications, or workflow automation solutions
* Experience working with large-scale data processing systems
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana or Sentry
* Experience improving application performance and scalability in production environments


**About King**
 With a mission of
 *Making the World Playful* 
 , King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as
 *Farm Heroes Saga* 
 . King games are played by more than 200 million monthly active users. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

title: Senior Software Engineer, iOS
description:
**Join us in building a world-class creative platform used by millions of people.**
 Our product, SCRL, is a powerful photo and video editing platform loved by millions of creators worldwide. We're looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to help build what comes next.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This isn't a typical iOS role. SCRL is a tool people use to create, not just consume. That means you'll be working on things most apps never touch: real-time image and video manipulation, complex multi-touch interactions, advanced layout systems, and performance-sensitive rendering pipelines.
   

  

 You'll work across the full depth of the app, from pixel-level rendering to fluid, responsive UI that feels effortless to use. The problems are hard, the users are demanding, and the bar for quality is high.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Core Product Engineering
   

  

* Build and evolve SCRL's editing engine, working on image processing, video rendering, and real-time visual effects.
* Design and implement complex interaction models: multi-touch gestures, precise object manipulation, drag, resize, snap, and transform.
* Solve hard problems in coordinate geometry, layout systems, and state management.
* Push performance to its limits, optimising rendering, memory usage, and responsiveness across a wide range of devices.


 Quality & Craft
   

  

* Own features end to end, from planning through to delivery.
* Write code that is fast, correct, and maintainable.
* Sweat the details that make the difference between a good tool and a great one.
* Work closely with design to get interactions, animations, and transitions feeling exactly right.


 Collaboration & Growth
   

  

* Contribute to architecture decisions and help shape the technical direction of the iOS codebase.
* Participate in code reviews, planning sessions, and technical discussions.
* Share knowledge and help raise the bar across the engineering team.
* Stay sharp on the latest in the iOS ecosystem and bring ideas back to the team.


 You should have
   

  

* Extensive experience in iOS development and Swift.
* Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and an intuition for performance.
* Experience building complex, interactive, gesture-driven interfaces.
* A deep understanding of UIKit, Core Animation, and the iOS rendering pipeline.
* The ability to reason about performance at a low level: frame rates, memory, GPU vs CPU tradeoffs.


 Strong signals
   

  

* Experience with image processing, video rendering, or real-time graphics on iOS.
* Familiarity with Metal, Core Image, AVFoundation, or similar frameworks.
* Background in creative tools, design software, or editor-style applications.
* Experience working on consumer apps with large user bases.
* Interest in geometry, math, or computational problem solving.


 What we offer
   

  

* The chance to work on genuinely hard, interesting problems every day.
* A product that millions of people use to create, not just another feed or dashboard.
* Real ownership and direct impact in a small, focused team.
* Great colleagues and office in central Stockholm.
* Competitive compensation and opportunities for professional development.


 We’re a growing team based in central Stockholm, working closely across disciplines to build products people love. We care deeply about craft, collaboration and creating a place where everyone can learn and grow.

title: Backend Developer (TypeScript)
description:
At Qred, we’re building the world's best bank for small businesses. Since launching 11 years ago, we’ve grown from startup to profitable fintech scale-up, now generating over 1 billion SEK in annual revenue and supporting 50,000+ entrepreneurs across Northern Europe. We combine smart technology, real data, and human judgment to make financing simple, fast, and fair. With bold growth plans and strong momentum across multiple markets, we’re now looking for Backend Developers for several teams for our next phase of growth.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Backend Developer at Qred, you will take end-to-end ownership of some systems that power our financial products. You will bridge the gap between technical execution and business impact by building scalable infrastructure while actively contributing to our transition into an agentic-first fintech. This mission-driven role offers the autonomy to implement solutions using agentic AI. This will directly improve the experience of thousands of small businesses.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Build secure, scalable backend services and third-party integrations that align with our long-term architectural vision.
* Collaborate closely with other engineers to design efficient solution and their implementations.
* Deploy, test, and monitor production code while maintaining proper logging, tracing, and system health dashboards.
* Drive the implementation of AI frameworks and automated agents to shift our platform toward an agentic-first operating model.
* Mitigate technical risk by adhering to compliant engineering practices and acting with urgency on security alerts or production incidents.


 Our stack: AWS Serverless, Typescript, Node.js, Claude Code, Grafana, Github Actions.
   

  

 What we’re looking for
   

  

 We are seeking a structured professional who thrives in a collaborative, focused environment and avoids the trap of multitasking. You have the ability to drive alignment across teams, manage a disciplined workflow, and take proactive ownership of complex problem spaces. You are motivated by building scalable frameworks and establishing high engineering maturity within a fast-paced fintech ecosystem.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Several years of professional experience in backend software engineering with Typescript.
* Strong knowledge of backend architecture, secure data transferring, and modern cloud environments.
* Practical exposure to using AI models, LLMs, or building automated agentic workflows.


 Why Qred?
   

  

 This is the place to be if you’re looking for a place to grow. Qred is growing fast, and our Qredsters along with it. With a non-bureaucratic organization and delegated responsibilities, we make sure there’s a short path from idea to action. In addition to our great culture, you get to work with the latest cutting-edge techniques, full ownership, and last but not least a bunch of great competent colleagues to learn from!
   

  

 One Last Thing
   

  

 This is a full-time, permanent position based in our headquarters in Stockholm. We believe our culture thrives when we work closely together, which is why we have an office-first approach. To balance this with some flexibility, we have the option of working remotely one day per week. We review applications on a rolling basis and while the start date is flexible, the right candidate can join us immediately.
   

  

 Qred celebrates diversity and does not discriminate based on ethnicity, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.
   

  

  

  

 Qred is an international FinTech scale-up that specializes in digital financing solutions for small businesses, with operations in the Nordics, Benelux, Germany and Brazil. We are passionate about helping small businesses thrive and grow, by providing them with business loans and credit cards. Right now we’re in an exciting phase of our journey that focuses on growth through smart product development and technology fueled by international expansion.

title: Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
**Description**
 Welcome to SSC Space (formerly Swedish Space Corporation), the perfect workplace for those passionate about technology in general and space in particular.
   

  

 With space organizations, research institutes, institutional and commercial actors as customers, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications, space consulting services, rocket and balloon systems, flight test services, satellite propulsion systems, and much more.
   

  

 SSC Space also has one of the world’s largest global networks of ground stations for satellite communications. We own and operate the Esrange Space Center in Kiruna, northern Sweden, with the aim of launching satellites in the near future.
   

  

 Are you ready to embark on an exciting journey with us to help Earth benefit from space?
   

  

 If you answer yes to this question, we invite you to seize the opportunity to make a significant impact as Software Engineer in our team. We are looking for a dedicated person who shares our core values of Customer passion, Care, Collaboration, Curiosity, and Courage.
   

  

 The Software unit within SSC Connect is entrusted to develop and maintain critical systems required to connect our customers with their satellites. As our Software Engineer, you’ll develop and maintain the critical systems that keep our customers connected with their satellites every day.
   

  

**Requirements**
 We think that you care - about your systems, your colleagues, and your users. That you have a creative and analytical mindset. You take responsibility, drive your own initiatives, and can learn and process technical details quickly. We also think that you appreciate both working autonomously and together with other people.
   

  

 We believe you have a BSc or similar degree in Computer Science or Engineering and several years of experience in software development.
   

  

 To succeed in this role, you should have:
   

  

* Proven experience in Go development
* Proven experience with git
* Proven experience with unit testing and system test scripting
* Experience developing and deploying applications on cloud platforms
* Solid knowledge of Linux environments
* Excellent communication skills in English.


**We Also Value If You Have Experience With**
* Experience building scalable and reliable infrastructure on cloud platforms
* Knowledge of Kubernetes
* Experience with message bus technologies (RabbitMq, NATS, Kafka)
* API development experience (RESTful / JSON / XML)
* Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD methodologies
* Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL)
* Interest or experience within the space industry.


 You must hold EU citizenship and be able to travel occasionally.
   

  

 This role is also critical for our operational services and may include participation in an on-call rotation (up to one week per month).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 We are seeking an experienced software engineer to:
   

  

* Build and maintain high-quality software for mission-critical applications.
* Advance automation in testing, deployment, and delivery.
* Enhance observability through monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions.
* Contribute to continuous improvement within our agile teams.
* Support live missions and ensure system reliability in production.


**Benefits**
**We offer you**
* A unique opportunity to contribute to a wide range of projects and play an active role in both the Swedish and international space industry.
* An excellent opportunity for personal and career development.
* An exciting, international workplace characterized by an open atmosphere and proud employees all over the world.


**Additional benefits**
* In addition to vacation and traditional public holidays, we offer extra paid leave throughout the year, such as time off between Christmas and New Year, Ascension Day, amounting to 6-11 extra days depending on the calendar.
* Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year.
* Health benefits such as voluntary health insurance and regular health checks for eligible employees.
* Access to a benefit bike through a tax-efficient leasing program.
* Support for employee-driven activities that promote connection, health, and culture across teams.
* Collective Agreement, including good pensions plans, parental pay and insurance.


**LOCATION** 

 This is a full-time, permanent position based at our office in either Solna or Kiruna.
   

  

**FURTHER INFORMATION**
 For questions regarding the position, you are welcome to contact:
   

  

 Jenny Rudenstål, Global Software Engineering Manager: jenny.rudenstal@sscspace.com.
   

  

 For questions regarding employment terms or union-related matters, you are welcome to contact our union representatives:
   

  

 Sveriges Ingenjörer: SverigesIngenjorer-AF@sscspace.com
   

  

 Unionen: unionen@sscspace.com
   

  

  

  

**NEXT STEP** 

 If this opportunity sparks your interest, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible! We review applications continuously and will conduct interviews throughout the process.
   

  

 You can submit your application up until 2026-09-27, which is the latest possible date for consideration.
   

  

 Please note, however, that the position may be filled before this date, and the advertisement may therefore close earlier. This allows us to manage the process efficiently and give each application the attention it deserves.
   

  

 When applying, please include your CV. While you are welcome to include a brief personal note or letter, our evaluation will primarily focus on your skills and qualifications as outlined in your CV, ensuring a fair and unbiased recruitment process.
   

  

 This position requires approved pre-employment screening. These controls are based on the role that you will fulfill within the company. Additional requirements regarding citizenship may apply.
   

  

**WE HELP EARTH BENEFIT FROM SPACE**
 SSC Space is a leading global provider of advanced space services, with more than 50 years of experience. We help space organizations, research institutes, commercial and institutional actors from all over the world to get access to space.
   

  

 With local presence on all continents and about 700 committed employees, we offer specialist expertise in satellite communications and satellite control services, spacecraft operations, rocket and balloon systems, launch services and flight test services, as well as engineering, operations and consultancy services for space missions.
   

  

 We help Earth benefit from Space. Learn more at sscspace.com

title: Full-Stack Engineer, Platform & Integrations - HealthTech
description:
**Full-Stack Engineer, Platform & Integrations**
 Velora Health, AI-native HealthTech
   

  

* Stockholm, hybrid
* Full-time


 Stack: React and React Native
   

  

* Hono on Bun
* Drizzle and PostgreSQL
* Google Cloud Platform
* Stripe, Firebase, BankID, PostHog


**About Velora Health**
 Velora Health is a rapidly growing AI HealthTech startup on a mission to address the leading causes of preventable death. Our goal is bold yet simple: a longer and healthier life for more people, through the fusion of personalized care and a holistic approach to health.
   

  

 We started by tackling one of the biggest global health issues: obesity, which affects nearly 1 billion people worldwide. Through our platform and digital health clinic at velora.se we have already helped thousands of patients lose weight and keep it off, which means they live longer and with fewer diseases such as type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease. In Sweden alone, 2 million people could live longer with Velora. We are now expanding beyond obesity into broader chronic care, giving people access to the latest and most effective research-based treatments.
   

  

 We are AI-native and use AI across the whole company. Today we are a 20-person team across clinical care, engineering, growth and operations. In engineering you will have five or six colleagues you work closely with every day across engineering, product and design, plus the clinicians who use what you build. We run two products on one TypeScript codebase, Velora Tools for our clinicians and the patient portal (web app plus two native apps), and we ship to production every week.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Velora is looking for a full-stack engineer to own the systems that have to be right: payments and subscriptions, identity, third-party integrations and the internal platform (Velora Tools) our care team runs on. You will own outcomes, not just tasks: when a Stripe webhook arrives out of order or BankID behaves unexpectedly, you are the person who understands the whole path and decides where the fix belongs.
   

  

 The interesting work here is rarely an isolated endpoint. It is understanding the entire flow, choosing where logic lives, handling failure properly and keeping the platform easy to change as we grow.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
*We build two products on one TypeScript codebase: Velora Tools, the system our clinicians run their day on, and the patient portal, a web app plus two native apps (iOS and Android). You will work across both, with Velora Tools and the shared platform as your home turf.*
* Build product, end-to-end: take a clinician or patient problem from investigation through the React UI, the Hono API and PostgreSQL to production, and follow it there.
* Think in systems and abstractions: see the platform behind the feature request, decide where the logic belongs and build the right primitive once for Velora Tools, the web app and both native apps.
* Evolve Velora Tools so clinicians and operations can work accurately and fast, from schemas to screens.
* Own the payments and subscriptions domain: Stripe flows, webhooks, retries, reconciliation and the data model behind them.
* Build and harden integrations with BankID, Firebase and external services, designing for partial failure and inconsistent responses.
* Add the logging, monitoring and error handling that make production understandable, and investigate incidents when they happen.
* Improve CI/CD, local development and testing on Google Cloud so the team ships faster with more confidence.


**You may be a good fit if you**
* Have 3+ years of experience building and operating production backend or full-stack systems, ideally in TypeScript.
* Think in failure modes: idempotency, retries, ordering, timeouts and what the user sees when something breaks.
* Can operate as a team of one when needed, taking a problem from investigation to production, while bringing in the right people when a decision affects the wider product.
* Own outcomes, not just code. You care whether the payment was actually correct, not whether the ticket was closed.
* Prefer the smallest change that solves the problem and can tell when a new abstraction is warranted.
* Hold yourself to a high bar without needing external pressure.
* Use AI tools daily, stay up to date as models, tools and best practices evolve, and confidently question generated answers, verify assumptions and recognise when privacy, security or correctness require extra care.


**Strong candidates will have**
* Built or owned payment, subscription or identity systems in production.
* Proficiency across the stack (TypeScript, React, a Node/Bun backend, PostgreSQL) with depth on the backend.
* Experience running services on GCP or a comparable cloud, including CI/CD, secrets and observability.
* Experience in healthcare, fintech or another regulated environment.
* A track record of shipping independently, not just contributing to larger efforts.

title: Senior Researcher in Video Coding
description:
**Grow with us**
**About The Opportunity**
 Ericsson is Europe’s leading network technology company and a global pioneer shaping the 6G era. Our 6G vision will transform business and society in the 2030s through secure, efficient, and sustainable communications.
   

  

 Video already accounts for 75% of mobile data traffic. In an AI-enabled world of immersive experiences, digital twins, autonomous systems, and generative media, advanced video coding is indispensable. To deliver these services on a global scale, video compression and standards must keep advancing in efficiency, flexibility, and sustainability.
   

  

 Join our international team of world-class researchers at the forefront of both advanced signal processing and neural network–based compression. You will invent, implement, and evaluate algorithms that power next-generation video coding standards shaping the technology stack of 6G and AI-native media.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Invent novel video coding tools (signal processing and neural approaches) to improve video coding performance and efficiency as well as invent ways to increase robustness and flexibility of video coding standards.
* Implement inventions in software (C++/Python) and run large-scale evaluations.
* Drive technical contributions to JVET/MPEG standardization, author patents and publications.
* Collaborate with researchers and engineers across Ericsson as well as leading industry and academia experts globally.
* Contribute to Ericsson’s video coding research and standardization strategy.
* Provide technical leadership and supervision.


**The Skills You Bring**
 We welcome experienced candidates who:
   

  

* Hold M.Sc. or Ph.D. in a relevant technical field.
* Have a proven track record of video coding research with evidence of adopted contributions to JVET/MPEG (and/or other relevant SDOs), granted patents, or peer-reviewed publications.
* Have a proficient knowledge of relevant video coding standards (e.g., HEVC/H.265, VVC/H.266), deep understanding of image and video processing algorithms across end-to-end video coding pipeline and solid expertise in codec high-level syntax.
* Have experience of driving and leading technical work.
* Have strong coding skills in C++ and/or Python.
* Can communicate complex technical ideas clearly and concisely.


**Nice to have:**
* Experience of holding editor, coordinator, or ad-hoc group roles in JVET/MPEG or relevant SDOs.
* Experience of shaping organization’s video coding standardization strategy.
* Experience of technical leadership in an international research team.
* Experience of giving talks or tutorials at relevant academia and industry events.


**Why join Ericsson:**
* Be part of Europe’s leading tech company at the forefront of 6G and global standards.
* Work with a top-tier international research team and shape direction of next generation video coding standards.
* Have a real impact at scale with your innovations targeting billions of devices and a large share of global data traffic.
* Perform at your best, enabled by a healthy work-life balance and a commitment to long-term, sustainable progress.


**Location:** 
 for this job opportunity is Stockholm Sweden. For exceptional candidates other locations may be considered
   

  

**How to apply:**
 Send your application and describe how your experience and skills will advance state-of-the-art video coding for the AI-enabled 6G world.

title: Data Engineer
description:
På B3 Indes förvandlar vi data till värdefulla insikter som driver förändring och innovation. Vi skapar lösningar inom AI, Business Intelligence, Data Science och Automation för att maximera värdet av data och stärka företags konkurrenskraft. Vår styrka ligger i att kombinera passion för AI och data med en stark laganda, där vi stöttar varandra och löser utmaningar tillsammans.
   

  

**Rollen inom Data Engineering på B3:**
 Hos oss får du chansen att jobba med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder och projekt. Vad innebär det? Jo, att du får:
   

  

* Gräva i och tillgängliggöra data som inte bara hjälper våra kunder – utan kanske till och med gör världen lite bättre.
* Göra företag mer datadrivna och smartare genom att guida dem i rätt riktning.
* Designar, modellerar och utveckla datalager som bygger på ett eller flera olika källsystem.
* Bygga och implementera avancerade lösningar – och faktiskt se dem göra skillnad!


 Här handlar det inte bara om teknik – det handlar om att modellera, tillgängliggöra och förvalta flöden av data som kan skapa verklig förändring. Vi gillar att tänka stort, experimentera och lösa kluriga problem tillsammans. Och det bästa? Du får ett team av grymma kollegor att bolla idéer med, lära dig av och ha kul ihop med!
   

  

****Det är din passion för** 
 data och analys som gör skillnaden. Utöver det ser vi gärna:**
* Har du en relevant universitetsutbildning? Toppen! Har du kanske skaffat motsvarande kunskaper genom arbetslivserfarenhet? Det funkar lika bra!
* Minst 4 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet – vi letar efter någon som har hunnit samla på sig en del erfarenhet inom området.
* Flytande svenska och engelska – eftersom båda språken används dagligen i arbetet.
* Tidigare konsultroller är ett plus! Har du jobbat som konsult tidigare? Då är det en extra merit, men inget krav.


**Men framför allt...**
 Har du djup erfarenhet av rollen som Data Engineer? Fantastiskt – det är viktigt! Men vi lägger också stor vikt vid din förmåga att se helheten, skapa användbara lösningar men framför allt att du är nyfiken. Om du dessutom har erfarenhet av flera olika moderna ramverk och utvecklarverktyg för t.ex ETL/ELT-flöden, Databaser, Data Warehouse, DataLake, Datamodellering och DevOps – är det ett stort plus.
   

  

 Vi ser även gärna att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat i en eller flera molnplattformar – Azure, AWS, GCP.
* Kanske har du också lite koll på någon av de andra vanligaste BI-verktygen (ex; Power BI eller Qlik)
* Snowflake, Databricks eller något datalager automationsverktyg (ex: TimeXtender eller Wade)
* Viss erfarenhet av att arbeta med arkitektur


**Varför välja B3 Indes?**
 💡
 **Utveckling & karriär** 
 – Väx i en entreprenörsdriven miljö där din kompetens får ta plats.
   

  

 🌿
 **Balans & välmående** 
 – Vi värnar om ditt välbefinnande med stöd för wellness och en flexibel vardag.
   

  

 🚀
 **Energi & gemenskap** 
 – Här präglas kulturen av öppenhet, nyfikenhet och en passion för att skapa något större – tillsammans.
   

  

 ❤️
 **Vi bryr oss – på riktigt** 
 – Vi engagerar oss i samhällsfrågor och samarbetar med initiativ som Suicide Zero, My Dream Now och Pink Programming för att göra skillnad även utanför arbetslivet.
   

  

**En arbetsplats som gör skillnad** 
 :
   

  

 Vi är stolta över att ha utsetts till ett av
 **Sveriges fem främsta karriärföretag 2025** 
 – en utmärkelse som speglar vår energi, nyfikenhet och vårt engagemang för att skapa en inkluderande och inspirerande arbetsplats. Här värdesätts olika perspektiv och idéer, och vi tror att det är just det som gör oss starkare.
   

  

 Hos oss får du friheten att styra över dina uppdrag, din arbetstid och din utveckling. Vi erbjuder
 **konkurrenskraftiga löner** 
 , flexibilitet att forma din vardag och en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid. Och vi vet att
 **gemenskap är minst lika viktigt som teknik** 
 – därför satsar vi på allt från konferensresor och sommarfester till sköna AW:s där vi kan släppa jobbet för en stund.
   

  

**Om B3 Consulting Group**
*B3 Consulting Group är ett expansivt konsultbolag med cirka 1000 medarbetare. Vi brinner för innovation och hjälper Sveriges ledande företag och organisationer att skapa framtidens möjligheter genom digital transformation. B3 finns på* 
 tolv orter i Sverige samt i Polen, med huvudkontor i Stockholm. Bolaget grundades 2003, är noterat på Nasdaq Stockholm Small Cap och omsatte 1 141 MSEK 2023.
   

  

*Vi är stolta över vår prisbelönta företagskultur, där olikheter, erfarenheter och gemensam energi värdesätts. Som ett etiskt och transparent bolag strävar vi efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi är även engagerade i* 
 Women in Tech och initiativ för att stärka AI-utbildning för kvinnor. 2024 utsågs vi till Årets Employer Branding-företag, och vår HR-chef vann titeln Årets HR-chef.
   

  

**Är du redo att bli en del av ett företag där din passion för AI och data kan göra skillnad? Läs mer om oss och våra möjligheter här!**

title: People Manager - Experience Engineering
description:
Choosing Capgemini means joining a global community where you can shape your career, collaborate with inspiring colleagues, and reimagine what’s possible. In our Digital Customer Experience (DCX) team, we design smart, inclusive solutions that transform how people interact with digital services through data, design, and technology. Together with leading technology partners, we deliver meaningful experiences that make a real difference for people and businesses, while shaping a more sustainable future. Join us and help create exceptional customer experiences!
   

  

**Your role**
 We are looking for a Senior Frontend/Fullstack Developer who is ready to take the next step in their career. As a People Manager within our experience engineering team you will combine hands-on client delivery with leadership responsibilities, supporting and developing a team of 4–5 consultants while helping our clients build modern digital solutions.
   

  

*In this role you will play a key role in:*
* Working as a senior consultant in client assignments, designing, developing, and delivering modern digital solutions.
* Supporting, coaching, and developing a team of consultants, helping them grow professionally and succeed in their careers.
* Managing performance reviews, development discussions, and mentoring, while ensuring consultants have the skills and capabilities needed to meet client and business needs.
* Contributing to recruitment, sales activities, and the continued growth of our fullstack team.


**Your Profile**
* You have at least 6 years of experience in frontend and/or fullstack development, with expertise in JavaScript, React and/or Angular, and experience working with modern web technologies, backend solutions, and APIs.
* You have experience working with Content management systems (CMS) such as Optimizely, AEM, Contentful, Sitevision or similar.
* You are passionate about AI and have experience with, or a strong interest in, AI-powered tools and technologies.
* You are motivated by leading, coaching, and inspiring others, and have experience working in consulting, digital development, or a related technology field.
* You understand customer needs in a complex and evolving digital environment and are comfortable building strong relationships with clients and colleagues alike.
* You have a relevant university degree, and good knowledge of Swedish and English.


**About**
**What we believe you will enjoy about working here**
* We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
* All employees are covered by a collective agreement and receive occupational pension, insurance, parental benefits and health care allowance – among other best-in-class benefits.
* Exciting career opportunities locally and internationally, and fantastic networks of expertise. With over 4000 colleagues in Sweden only, you are part of a sharp, technology and business focused community, where more than 250 000 (!) courses and certifications are offered to all employees.


**Application**
 Do not hesitate to submit your application. We will be conducting interviews on a rolling basis and look forward to finding our next colleague!
   

  

*As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card, and background checks may be carried out as required.*
**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22.1 billion.
   

  

 Make it real | www.capgemini.com

title: People Manager (Platform & Data Engineering)
description:
At Capgemini, you have the opportunity to shape your career in a way that fits your life, your goals, and your ambitions – supported by a collaborative team where knowledge sharing and continuous learning are part of everyday work. We believe in reimagining what’s possible and using technology to build a more sustainable and inclusive future. Our Insights & Data team leads the way in this mission, delivering end-to-end Data & AI solutions across industries. With over 550 specialists in the Nordics and strong partnerships with Google, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, and Snowflake, we scale next‑generation Cloud Data & Analytics with impact. Here, your skills matter, your ideas matter, and your growth matters. Join us and be part of transforming industries with cutting-edge data innovation. We value diverse perspectives and know that innovation happens when people with different backgrounds and experiences come together. We actively encourage people from underrepresented groups in tech to apply.
   

  

 Ready to elevate your career? We are now looking for our next People Manager within the AI & Data Engineering unit - a role that brings together leadership, technical depth, and genuine influence.
   

  

**Your role**
**As a Data Engineer with a focus on Azure
 **,** 
 GCP, Fabric, Snowflake or Databricks, you will:**
* Design and build efficient and scalable data pipelines using tools like Fabric, Databricks and Apache Spark in Azure.
* Develop secure, scalable data lakehouses and warehouses, including data models and quality frameworks.

* Strong knowledge of data warehouse concepts and hands-on experience with Azure services (Azure Data Lake Storage, Databricks, Azure Data Factory).
